name: a Sunday-night workout that arrives with Monday's push still counts for its week
comment: Lifts 2026-09-14..09-27 Mon/Wed/Fri 40 min at 140 = 120: weeks 09-14 and 09-21 hit, streak 2.
Week 09-28 holds two lifts (09-28, 09-30, 120 each) in the base inputs. The Sunday run is added in stage 3.
A week closes after the first health push following Monday 00:00 local, or after week_close_grace_hours (12) with no push.
Stage 1, Mon 10-05 00:30 EDT (04:30Z): the last push was Sunday 22:00Z, none since Monday 00:00 (04:00Z), grace not passed -> week 09-28 still open: week_hit null, streak 2.
Stage 2, Mon 13:00 EDT (17:00Z): no push since 04:00Z and 04:00Z + 12 h = 16:00Z has passed -> the week closes on what is stored: 2 < 3, week_hit false, streak 0.

Stage 3: the 18:00Z push carries R-2026-10-04, Sunday 21:30-22:10 EDT (start day Sunday -> week 09-28; end 02:10Z Monday). 20 @140 (60) + 20 @155 (80) = 140 >= 100 -> third dot: quality_workouts 3, week_hit true, streak 3, week_complete_at = its end 2026-10-05T02:10:00Z. The recompute re-opened and re-scored the closed week from stored data.
